open_context.police: OpenStreetMap contextual locations only; not authoritative operational security database

derived.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM 2024_1; DSM, not DTM; EGM2008 vertical reference

synthetic.demo_reports: Generated solely to demonstrate reporting, verification and action workflow.

interpretation_limits.tree_cover: WorldCover tree class is not equivalent to gazetted/legal forest estate.
interpretation_limits.jrc: JRC surface-water metrics are historical context, not current flooding.
interpretation_limits.police: Two mapped OSM police locations do not represent complete security coverage.
interpretation_limits.communities: OSM mapped settlements are not an authoritative census settlement database.
interpretation_limits.building_clusters: Derived concentration polygons are not official community boundaries.
interpretation_limits.population: WorldPop is modelled gridded population, not household census enumeration.
interpretation_limits.reports: All demonstration incident records are synthetic.
